body: Forward test of the promise-tracker method (not a recommendation). Probability 0.65 that: Uniparts FY27 consolidated revenue growth ≥20% YoY. Reason: H1 +32% gives cushion for 24% guide; cyclical risk in H2. Resolve by 2027-05-31; score with Brier.
title: Paper call: Uniparts FY27 consolidated revenue growth ≥20% YoY
